jobs.title: National Director of Wellness Strategy
jobs.description:
At Allbright, we curate extraordinary living, and we believe wellbeing is at the heart of that experience. Through personalized, preventative, and whole person approaches to health and wellness, we help residents and members better understand their health, take ownership of their wellbeing, and live healthier, more connected lives.

We are seeking a National Director of Wellness Strategy
to lead the development and evolution of our national wellness strategy, with an immediate focus on Allbright, functional health and wellness clinics, and Lifestyle Residences. The role will establish the strategy, standards, and partnerships needed to deliver integrated, evidence-informed wellness experiences that bring together clinical insight, diagnostics, fitness, lifestyle programming, and personalized wellness planning.

Meaningful Benefits

Comprehensive health, vision, and dental benefits
Employee and Family Assistance Program
Life, travel, and other insurance benefits
Access to virtual healthcare services
RRSP contribution matching
Vacation accrual starting immediately
Employee discounts through WorkPerks
Continuing education and professional development opportunities
Access to the Shannex Centre of Excellence
Recognition and rewards programs
Opportunities to contribute to innovation and continuous improvement

About The Opportunity

Develop and champion a national wellness strategy, philosophy, roadmap, and governance framework
Design and evolve integrated wellness offerings that connect assessments, diagnostics, personalized health planning, fitness, lifestyle, and interdisciplinary programming
Establish consistent standards, frameworks, and operating models that support high-quality, evidence-informed, and scalable wellness experiences
Partner with clinical leaders, practitioners, operations, hospitality, and external specialists to create coordinated and personalized wellness experiences
Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of wellness programs, providing tools, training, resources, and guidance to support consistent delivery
Establish measures of success and use data, feedback, and outcomes to inform strategy and continuous improvement
Build strategic relationships with healthcare providers, wellness organizations, practitioners, researchers, and other external partners
Serve as an ambassador for the organization and contribute to its profile as a leader in modern, integrated, and preventative wellness
Build organizational capability in wellness strategy, innovation, and execution while fostering a culture of wellbeing, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

About You

In addition to placing high value on collaboration, innovation, accountability, and service excellence, you bring:

Post-secondary education in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Degree or certification in health, wellness, kinesiology, public health, business, or a related field would be considered an asset
Senior leadership experience in wellness, health services, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing wellness programs, services, or strategies
Strong understanding of whole-person, preventative, and personalized approaches to health and wellbeing
Strong relationship-building, communication, and influencing skills.
The ability to translate emerging wellness trends, research, and evidence into practical and differentiated offerings
A demonstrated ability to balance strategic vision with practical execution and operational realities

Show less
